content.text: She was testing him. A king would take the gift and leave them alone; a prophet would turn it down and want only their faith. Al-Tabari, Ibn Kathir and al-Qurtubi all explain it this way.
Al-Tabari: if he is a prophet he will not accept the gift, and nothing from us will please him but that we follow his religion; if he is a king he will accept it and leave.

citations.cited_text: إن يكن نبيا لم يقبل الهدية

content.text: Ibn Kathir: "I will send him a gift befitting for one of his status, and will wait and see what his response will be."

citations.cited_text: I will send him a gift befitting for one of his status, and will wait and see what his response will be.

content.text: Al-Qurtubi: this was from her good judgement and planning; she would test this man with a gift.
